name: io.github.chrischall/zola-mcp
description: Zola wedding planning for Claude — vendors, budget, guests, seating, registry, and RSVPs

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zola refresh token JWT (~1 year lifetime). Optional — when unset, the MCP falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension to read the `usr` cookie from your signed-in zola.com tab, and caches it so later starts need no browser.
